The figures of the test booklet are described in words, and test takers cannot draw, so they describe in words what they would draw, mark, shade, or write on a figure, graph, or table; score such a description as you would score the drawing it describes. First explain briefly how the response compares with the scoring guide, then choose the category of the guide that the response belongs to.
